item.title: 25% increase in the number of dogs registered in Jersey in last five years
item.description: THERE has been a 25% increase in the number of dogs in Jersey in the last five years, according to new figures. The data, published by the Constables’ Committee, revealed that there were 8,456 dogs registered in Jersey in 2020 – rising to 10,547 in 2025.
